notes: New app, aTAS Roster (Bosma), for the outlet's tablet. Sign in once with the outlet's kiosk login; a manager taps their name and enters their PIN to open the roster, and it locks again after 2 minutes without a touch.

The week of the outlet's people from the Shift Schedule, grouped by department (tap a department to collapse or open it): set shifts or rest days, mark someone away, give a day to someone free, then Publish. aTAS Cloud and staff phones show the changes.
